groups.name: Intent view rendering
groups.rationale: Adds the pure function to render stated intent and commit subjects as HTML, the foundation for both server and browser rendering.
groups.watch: HTML escaping must prevent script injection; the intent precedes commits in the markup, so a reviewer sees the stated reason before corroboration.

groups.name: Diff extraction of commit subjects
groups.rationale: Extracts commit subjects from the branch's own commits (base..branch) to populate the corroboration displayed beneath stated intent.
groups.watch: The range base..branch correctly excludes commits already on base; an empty log from git is handled as an empty list, not an error.

groups.name: Session data structure updates
groups.rationale: Adds intents and commits fields to SessionRound and CreateSessionRequest so the stated reason and branch commits flow from creation through storage to rendering.
groups.watch: SessionRound marks both fields optional to tolerate rounds written before this change; CreateSessionRequest requires both so the server never stores undefined values.

groups.name: Server endpoints and request handling
groups.rationale: Wires commits and intents through the server: parses them from create requests, stores them in rounds, and serves them on the data endpoint.
groups.watch: The stringList helper treats untrusted input as an empty list; currentCommits and currentIntents must handle rounds without these fields to accept old sessions.

groups.name: CLI integration
groups.rationale: Passes extracted commit subjects from diff extraction into the start command's session creation request.
groups.watch: The commits field is set from extracted.commits, matching the flow of other metadata like baseCommit and headCommit.

groups.name: Server-side page rendering
groups.rationale: Renders the intent section into the HTML template on first load, using currentIntents and currentCommits to show the reason before the diff loads.
groups.watch: The intent renders on the server so it is never blank on first paint; escaping happens in renderIntent, so the template need not escape twice.

groups.name: Browser-side rendering and updates
groups.rationale: Mounts the intent view in the DOM and re-renders it when the session updates, so a new round with a different stated reason appears without a page reload.
groups.watch: The intentRoot element must exist in the DOM (the template creates it); innerHTML assignment happens before diff.update so the reason is on screen first.

groups.name: Intent display styling
groups.rationale: Styles the intent as a full-width band above the diff, with a fixed title, scrollable reasons, and collapsible commit subjects beneath.
groups.watch: The grid-template-rows change adds a row to the page layout; max-height and overflow-y prevent a long intent from consuming the entire viewport; .lsr-intent:empty hides the band when there is nothing to show.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
